reachedBy.why: /de/confirmation with no parameters calls notFound() at app/[locale]/confirmation/page.tsx:45 and renders the error state headed 'Diese Seite wurde abgeschnitten.' The page needs booking_id. This record is the REAL confirmation screen, not that error state.

bookingUsed.existing: yes, seeded. Nothing was created and nothing was written. Found with a read-only service-role SELECT run from a throwaway script in the scratchpad, never in the repo.
bookingUsed.whyThisOne: Of the 998 seeded bookings it is the most recent one that is status 'confirmed', has a user_id (so the RLS cookie path can read it without an access_token), has a staff_member_id (so the stylist row renders), and carries a reference_code. Ranked on those four and it came first.
bookingUsed.starts_at: 2026-08-27T13:40:00+00:00, which is 15:40 Europe/Zurich on the day of measurement

reachedBy.authPath: The COOKIE path, not the guest token path. booking.user_id is 356e0a76-0eb1-4144-9100-184db27403b5, whose auth email is verify-auth-rollout-test@proton.me, so RLS policy bookings_select_own authorizes the read once that user is signed in. No access_token was needed and none was used, because the row is not a guest booking. guest_bookings holds 0 rows in this database and 530 of 998 bookings have a null user_id, but none of those was used here.
steps: 1. In the same tab-114 at 402x844, navigate to http://localhost:3457/api/dev/login?email=verify-auth-rollout-test%40proton.me&to=%2Fde%2Fconfirmation%3Fbooking_id%3D28b93837-e515-4066-87f2-f75a1150652a . The dev-login route mints a magic link for that email, writes the session cookies onto its own 307, and redirects to the `to` path, so one navigation both signs in and lands on the screen.
2. Confirm the screen is the real one and not the error state: document.title reads 'Termin bestätigt!' and the h1 reads the same. The error state's heading is 'Diese Seite wurde abgeschnitten.'
3. Settle: sample the settle signature from scripts/measure-sections.mjs twice, 4 s apart. Both returned '23|2900|96480'.
4. Confirm the viewport survived the navigation: innerWidth 402, innerHeight 844, devicePixelRatio 2, scrollY 0.
5. Run the extractSections function body from scripts/measure-sections.mjs via javascript_tool.

statesThatCouldNotBeMeasured._why: Not omissions. Each one is gated on data that does not exist anywhere in this database, and the task is read only, so producing it would have meant writing a booking.
statesThatCouldNotBeMeasured.upcomingBooking: ZERO of the 998 seeded bookings has a starts_at in the future, checked against now with a single query. BookingConfirmation.tsx:258 computes isUpcoming from that, so on every reachable confirmation isUpcoming is false. Two blocks are therefore suppressed on the screen measured here and nothing in this record describes them: the red-text cancel button at line 592, gated on canCancel (line 273, needs isUpcoming), and the reschedule path gated on canReschedule (line 267, needs hoursUntilBooking > 24). The cancel button is a real render site with real JSX, it simply has no data that reaches it in this seed.
statesThatCouldNotBeMeasured.paidBooking: payment_status on this row is 'none', so isPaid is false. Three things follow. The h1 renders text-s-ink rather than the text-s-success it takes when isPaid (line 451). The green paid pill at line 553, rounded-pill bg-s-success-bg with a 13px Check icon, does not render, and its place is taken by the plain 'Im Salon bezahlen' line at line 559. Only 11 of 998 bookings carry a payment_intent_id at all.
statesThatCouldNotBeMeasured.splitPayment: The remainingAtSalonLabel branch at line 531, deposit paid online plus a remainder at the salon, needs remaining_at_salon to be set. Exactly 1 of 998 rows has it. Not measured.
statesThatCouldNotBeMeasured.vatLine: showVat switches the total label between t('totalInclVat') and t('total'). 0 of the 28 salons has vat_registered = true and this booking's vat_rate is null, so the plain 'Gesamtpreis' label rendered. The inkl-MwSt label was not measured.
statesThatCouldNotBeMeasured.guestVariant: props.isGuest gates the access-link card at line 599, a rounded-card with the raw lookup URL in font-mono-code 13px and a copy button. This booking has a user_id so isGuest is false and that card did not render.

Both are counted in the screen-level size and weight totals above, because extractSections walks document.body. The per-section specs treat them as chrome.

globalChrome.overlapAtRest: MEASURED, and it is an overlap, not a clearance. At scrollY 0 the fixed tab bar occupies viewport 774 to 832 at z-index 700, and the 'Kalender hinzufügen' button occupies 806 to 858. The two bands overlap by 26px and the bar paints over the button's top half. 311px of scroll is available (document 1155 against viewport 844) and the button clears the bar once scrolled, so this is a first-paint condition, not a permanent one. Recorded as measured, not judged.
